'''Hinakuu''' was a terrestrial celestial body located in the [[Hinakuu system/Legends|Hinakuu system]], a part of the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Tidal Circuit]] connected it to the [[Krinemonen system/Legends|Krinemonen]] and [[Sanctuary system]]s. Hinakuu was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by members of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]] expanding outward from their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], aboard Mon Calamari [[Starship/Legends|starliners]] between [[4400 BBY]] and [[4200 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hinakuu was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square U-6.<ref name="Atlas" />
